title: Norml WordPress Copilot Advanced
audience: WordPress developers working in CLI runtimes
actsOn: a local theme repo plus its GitHub and WordPress server
pitch: Connect the theme, GitHub, and server once; let the AI map the project; then develop and ship from a verified project contract.
pitchMark: Connect the theme, GitHub, and server once
problem: WordPress development context is often scattered across a laptop, GitHub, hosting notes, SSH config, and one developer's memory.
Advanced verifies those connections and stores the capability boundary, architecture, deploy contract, and work history inside the theme repo.

callout.label: CLI only
callout.text: Run it in **Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI**. It requires GitHub, SSH, remote WP-CLI, and a local theme repo; it does not run in Desktop / Cowork.

capabilities.label: What it does
capabilities.lede: The first scan proves the operating surface before development begins.

items.name: Connect the project
items.desc: Verifies local Git, GitHub origin, production SSH, remote WP-CLI, and optional staging.

items.name: Map architecture
items.desc: Combines read-only live WordPress evidence with a bounded local theme inventory.

items.name: Develop themes
items.desc: Builds within the recorded stack and project mode.

items.name: Ship through GitHub
items.desc: Branches, commits, CI/CD, staging QA, and production promotion.

items.name: Run in Desktop
items.desc: Desktop / Cowork uses the REST/API Norml WordPress Copilot instead.

flow.d: Add the skill to Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI.
Verify GitHub, production SSH, remote WP-CLI, and optional staging.
Generate capabilities.md and the theme-local architecture dossier.
Work locally within the detected Sage or inherited architecture.
Use GitHub, QA, confirmation, and backup-gated deployment.

commands: set up this project for Norml WordPress Copilot Advanced
add an ACF block following this theme's existing structure
rescan the WordPress and theme architecture
ship this branch to staging and run the QA gate
promote the verified staging release to production

limits.label: Boundary
items: No Claude Desktop / Cowork runtime; terminal and local filesystem are required.
No completed onboarding without a readable GitHub origin, production SSH, and remote WP-CLI.
No secret in chat, project config, .claude/, Git, or workflow source.
No production write without confirmation and verified backup acknowledgement.
limits.note: For REST/API content work without server access, use Norml WordPress Copilot.

architecture.label: Inside the skill
architecture.lede: The installed package keeps the CLI operating boundary, onboarding gates, cross-platform project tools, development guidance, generated contracts, and install path explicit.

items.role: CLI development boundary, project modes, onboarding gates, and delivery workflow.
Required GitHub, SSH, WP-CLI, scanner, and project-documentation sequence.
Cross-platform initialization, architecture scans, sync, SSH checks, and staged deployment.
Development conventions, Git workflow, QA, safety, and local WordPress guidance.
Theme-local capabilities, architecture, CI/CD, changelog, docs, and workflow contracts.
Supported CLI runtimes, prerequisites, first run, and credential rules.

architecture.note: This installed source stays separate from the committed theme-local .claude/ project record it generates.
